alerts.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued November 26 at 12:58PM PST until November 27 at 12:00PM PST by NWS Hanford CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...A few locations remain below a mile, and may not improve
much more during the day. Please exercise caution.

* WHERE...Caruthers - San Joaquin - Selma, Delano-Wasco-Shafter,
Fresno-Clovis, Hanford - Corcoran - Lemoore, Merced - Madera -
Mendota, Planada - Le Grand - Snelling, and Visalia - Porterville -
Reedley.

* WHEN...The next Dense Fog Advisory is from 8 PM this evening to
noon PST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Visibility a quarter mile or less will make driving
conditions hazardous again tonight and tomorrow morning.
alerts.instruction:
If driving, slow down, use your low beam headlights, and leave plenty
of distance ahead of you.
